Factset List of Underlyings With Barrier and Cash Flow Information.

params.name: _attributes
params.description: Limit the attributes returned in the response to the specified set.

items.docs: Provides details regarding the underlyings, their respective barriers and related cash flows (if any) of a securitized derivative. A unique combination of a cash flow and related barrier modalities, such as observation and level, is called a condition. In case of a securitized derivative with multiple underlyings, a condition comprises the respective barriers of all underlyings participating in that condition.
